subject.title: [Feature]: Memory/Context Improvements (metrics + global semantic search + conversation chaining + preload on restart)

question: Should this memory/context umbrella stay as one maintainer design item, or be split into scoped product/security design issues for metrics, session handoff, and restart preload?
rationale: The remaining work is not a single code defect; it defines new API, default, visibility, privacy, and lifecycle behavior across stable gateway and memory/session surfaces.

options.title: Split into scoped design items
options.body: Create narrower design issues for metrics visibility, session/context handoff, and restart preload so each can get privacy, default, and validation criteria before implementation.

options.title: Keep this as the canonical umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the coordination point and require future PRs to reference which slice they implement and how they avoid conflicting surfaces.

options.title: Close after linking narrower issues
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers explicitly decide the existing related issues fully replace the umbrella and preserve the remaining requirements there.

recommendation.title: Split into scoped design items
recommendation.body: Create narrower design issues for metrics visibility, session/context handoff, and restart preload so each can get privacy, default, and validation criteria before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This account appears in prior product review on the issue and in feature history for session memory and memory-search configuration.
